challenge.method: Read the complete opening notice through its changed-copy restriction, compared the companion GPLv3 control's opening notice, and checked whether LGPLv3 §2 or §6 extends this permission to edited license text.
challenge.results: No material contradiction. The changed-copy restriction defines the boundary of the verbatim permission. Section 2 addresses modifications to a Library, while §6 addresses publisher revisions and elections for covered Libraries. The GCC GPLv3 control carries a similar notice for its own document.

limitations: The permission concerns verbatim copies of the complete cited license document. Rights in software, marks, and any separate authority for a modified document fall outside the claim.
The two complete GNU plaintext acquisitions reported the same full-file digest, which matches the claim's provenance field. The opening range was independently hashed.
reasoning: The opening notice grants anyone permission to copy and distribute verbatim copies of the license document and expressly bars changing it. The recomputed claim SHA-256 matches the requested revision.
